manifest.method: One full warm-up per version and mode, excluded from timing summaries; five sequential measured pairs, reversing version order each pair. No profiler or full-step trace. Public seed 42 and periodic baseline; exact comparisons on every run.

scope.standalone: One full episode loop including policy, observations, action hashing, and reward accumulation; excludes initialization and final-state hashing.
scope.nsjail: Complete evaluator.evaluate with reproducibility verification: two fresh nsjail agents; includes initialization, simulation, IPC, scoring, teardown, replay comparison and final-state digest instrumentation; excludes Docker/Python startup, HTTP, queue, database.

limitations: Local WSL2 laptop measurements; user left other project work idle. No exclusive cores or fixed CPU clock; Windows background activity is not independently measured.
Five measured repeats per version; warm-ups excluded by the predeclared schedule. All measured samples are retained.
Public seed 42 and the periodic baseline only; these timings are not the full three-seed live suite or a Hetzner benchmark.
Standalone and sandbox have different timing scopes and Python runtimes. Compare before versus after within each mode.

No cProfile or full-step state trace in these timing runs. Exact checks cover every path result, actions, and full final state; the earlier separate 10,001-state mixed trace remains documented in FEE_CACHE_PERFORMANCE.md.
